args: set -euo pipefail; n=$(cargo test -q -p tier-drop-core -- --list 2>/dev/null | grep -c ': test$'); echo "tests: $n"; test "$n" -ge 25

set -euo pipefail; for f in registry qos plan floors disqualify decide holdout eval dataset review; do n=$(cargo test -q -p tier-drop-core "$f" -- --list 2>/dev/null | grep -c ': test$' || true); test "$n" -ge 1 || { echo "no test selected by $f"; exit 1; }; done

evidence_required: Per-test list mapping T-10…T-19 and T-22 assertions to test code.
Output of the three adversarial scratch tests.
objective: Independently verify the core engine: rerun the S-02 checks, confirm the tests assert what the requirements say, and add adversarial scratch tests.

outputs.purpose: QA verdict for S-02 with the test-to-assertion review and adversarial test results.

risk_controls: Run in a separate QA context that never implemented the slice; do not edit implementation files; a verdict is accept or reject with the failing check and defect list.
Adversarial tests live in a scratch file that is not committed.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's forbidden organisation name (grep pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden phrase (grep pattern needs[ ]you); plain, specific prose.
rollback: Delete qa/V-02 and the scratch test file; the implementation branch is unchanged.
steps: Read every test named in T-10…T-19 and T-22 and confirm each assertion in plan/requirements.md is actually asserted (not merely a test with that name).

Write one extra adversarial test in a scratch file (not committed) for each of: a tier-5 model placed first by ladder; a disqualification with a stale registry_as_of ignored by plan_next; a candidate below a floor never ranked above one that clears it; and confirm they pass.
Write the verdict (accept or reject with the failing check and defect list) to qa/V-02/verdict.md.
